entities.name: Kakkazan
entities.description: A spirit (kami) of Kamigawa shaped like an upright crocodile with ruby scales and eight arms, who controlled three other kami.

entities.name: Ryusaki Kumano
entities.description: A yamabushi whose plateau Kakkazan climbed.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane where Kakkazan was a spirit.

entities.name: Kami of Ash
entities.description: A three-legged spider-like kami supporting the body of a grey old man, controlled by Kakkazan.

entities.name: Kami of Searing Wind
entities.description: A three-legged spider-like kami supporting a lidless orange eye, controlled by Kakkazan.

entities.name: Kami of Black Glass
entities.description: A three-legged spider-like kami supporting a featureless head, controlled by Kakkazan.

events.summary: Kakkazan climbed Ryusaki Kumano's plateau in search of the yamabushi's rumored secret but was defeated.
events.quote: Kakkazan climbed Ryusaki Kumano 's plateau in search of the yamabushi 's rumored secret but was defeated.

relations.quote: Kakkazan also controlled three other kami , the Kami of Ash, Searing Wind, and Black Glass.

relations.note: Kakkazan sought his secret and was defeated.
